He looks down at his waist and legs, adjusting the hem of his shorts and pulling up his black socks. Behind him, a grey pillar features a whiteboard with handwritten Chinese characters and training metrics. (2) As the rhythmic movement begins, the man squats slightly and starts vibrating his torso and popping his hips in a synchronized dance. He stares directly into the camera with an exaggerated comical expression, puffing his cheeks and widening his eyes while holding the horizontal bar of the squat rack behind his neck. The gym background is brightly lit with green turf flooring and other fitness equipment visible. (3) The man continues the high-energy rhythmic dance, shifting his weight between his legs and making funny facial contortions. He maintains a playful and humorous gaze toward the viewer. At the end of the sequence, he breaks his intense expression, starts laughing, and reaches up with his right hand to touch his left shoulder as he stands upright.
